gui.chiseled_enchanting_table.grimoire.c: Timed Rituals & Two Skip Choices
Waiting ONLY appears when Broad Bookshelves reach %s+ OR stored Master Tomes total %s+ enchantments:
More Broad Bookshelves, more Tome enchants, higher relative tier, and universal enchants (Infinity, Mending) take longer — capped at 5 min each.
[Sacrifice XP Skip]: Directly spends whole XP levels based on remaining time (capped at 15 levels) to finish safely with 0% Tome damage.
[Force Rush Skip]: 0 XP cost, with live risk of turning a Master Tome into a Depleted Tome (the shelf still counts as an occupied Broad Bookshelf; max 50%, or 70% with Infinity).
No Tome = No Skip & Victim Order
Without a nearby Master Tome you cannot skip. Backfires always sacrifice the lowest-tier, fewest-enchant, commonest Tome first (unlocking Haste Makes Waste)!
gui.chiseled_enchanting_table.grimoire.d: Trigger Gate: %s+ Broad Bookshelves OR %s+ Master Tome enchants (smaller libraries finish in 0s!)
Pays 1–15 whole levels from live remaining time. Zero chance to hurt any stored book.

gui.chiseled_enchanting_table.grimoire.c: How 'Was XX Levels' & Gates Work
Hovering an option shows 'Bookshelf Discount: -X% (Was Y Levels)' — here is what that really means:
[How 'Was Y Levels' is set]: Just like a vanilla Lv.30 table, base gate scales from ~12 up to 30 for max tier (or higher for rare treasures); upgrading existing tiers credits 85% of old progress!
[Use in Green-Orb Mode]: Your entry ticket, NOT full cost! At -40%, 'Was 30' becomes Lv.18 to click — you only spend 1–3 levels and keep XP bar %! This also stops low-level free-XP loops.
[Use in Purple-Flask Mode]: Without a Master Tome, the discounted level is actually paid in full — which is why storing a Tome saves tons of XP!
Quick Takeaway
No Tome = pay the full discounted levels (Purple). Stored Tome = just meet the discounted gate and spend 1–3 levels (Green)!
gui.chiseled_enchanting_table.grimoire.d: Base 'Was 30 Levels' with full -%s%% library discount -> Gate becomes Lv.%s!

No Tome Yet (Purple Flask): Full Cost

Keep each Infinity Master Tome lean (at most 3 other enchants, <=4 total) for permanent 0-wear copying with 0% slip!

gui.chiseled_enchanting_table.grimoire.c: Classification des bibliothèques
'Bookshelves' fall into clear categories — here is how every type counts across the mod:

[Broad Bookshelves = All 3 Combined]: Includes (1) Regular Bookshelves, (2) Empty Chiseled Bookshelves, and (3) Book-Holding Chiseled Bookshelves (including plain books, grimoires, Enchanted Books, AND Depleted Tomes).
[Book-Holding Chiseled Shelves]: A Chiseled Bookshelf holding plain Books or Depleted Tomes counts as a Broad Bookshelf (not a Master Tome); ONLY Enchanted Books also act as Master Tomes!

[Who Controls What]: Direct upgrade gates, -15% wooden discount, Epiphany (32+) & table book-restoration use Regular Bookshelves; Tome healing (38/42), ritual wait (32+) & slip density use Broad Bookshelves.
Depleted Tomes Keep Your Shelf Tier
If a Master Tome degrades into a Depleted Tome, that Chiseled Bookshelf remains an occupied Broad Bookshelf — your 38/42 healing tier never drops!

gui.chiseled_enchanting_table.grimoire.c: Vestiges du monde & Libraires
Depleted Tomes also spawn across the world and trade exclusively with [Librarian] villagers:

[Chests & Wild Chiseled Shelves]: Found in dungeon, temple, mansion, ancient city & stronghold library chests (10%–55%), plus weathered wild Chiseled Bookshelves (total book replacement strictly <=30%, ~17.8% avg).
[Librarian Buyback]: Exclusively Librarian villagers buy Depleted Tomes at 2 Depleted Tomes = 1 Emerald OR 2 Amethyst Shards.

[Dynamic Villager Rank Gate + Dynamic Price]: Plain Books unlock at Lv.1 (4 Lapis / 2 Ink / 1 Emerald). Rewriting into Enchanted Books dynamically sets BOTH required Librarian rank (Novice Lv.1 – Master Lv.5) AND price via (Rarity x Universality x Relative Level), capped below vanilla Mending's typical price!
Great Early-Game Boost
